description: 3rd connection of this batch. 2nd connection fixed both self-inflicted bugs (sed -i / missing PATH export) and makei build actually ran this time - it invoked `/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/make -k ... -f /QOpenSys/pkgs/lib/tobi/src/mk/Makefile all`, but the result was `make: Nothing to be done for 'all'. Objects: 0 failed 0 succeed 0 total` - makei decided there was nothing to build. This is ambiguous: it could mean makei considers ZAISRV up to date because *MODULE/*SRVPGM objects with that name already exist in &LIB (Part 7's pre-existing ones, untouched by any of this batch's connections so far), independent of source content/dates - or it could mean something else entirely (no primary source for makei's own dependency-decision logic exists in this repo). This connection targets a library with zero pre-existing objects instead (&LIB2 = &LIB's sibling 'B' library, confirmed empty per docs/probes.md P01) via iproj.json's objlib/curlib, to get an unambiguous answer to both open questions at once: does `makei build` ever actually create objects from a clean slate, and does iproj.json's objlib/curlib genuinely control the target library. Non-destructive - &LIB2 has never been touched by this repo's harness for anything ZAISRV-related, so a failed or a successful build here can't damage anything Part 7 established in &LIB.

steps.label: SETUP
steps.cmd:
rm -rf "$HOME/mk8"
mkdir -p "$HOME/mk8/z/src/qrpglesrc" "$HOME/mk8/z/src/qsrvsrc"
system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QRPGLESRC.FILE/ZAISRV.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/mk8/z/src/qrpglesrc/zaisrv.rpgle') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1
system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QSRVSRC.FILE/ZAISRV.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/mk8/z/src/qsrvsrc/zaisrv.bnd') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1
system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QTXTSRC.FILE/IPROJJSN.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/mk8/z/iproj.json') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1
system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QTXTSRC.FILE/RULESMK.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/mk8/z/Rules.mk') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1
/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/python3 -c "p='$HOME/mk8/z/iproj.json'; d=open(p,'rb').read(); open(p,'wb').write(d.replace(b'YOURUSER2', b'&LIB2'))"
echo ---IPROJ-JSON---
cat "$HOME/mk8/z/iproj.json"
echo ---TREE---
find "$HOME/mk8/z" -type f

steps.sql: SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJLIB, OBJTEXT FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB2', 'ALL')) X WHERE OBJNAME = 'ZAISRV' ORDER BY OBJTYPE
SELECT PROGRAM_LIBRARY, PROGRAM_NAME, PROGRAM_TYPE, PROGRAM_OWNER FROM QSYS2.PROGRAM_INFO WHERE PROGRAM_LIBRARY = '&LIB2' AND PROGRAM_NAME = 'ZAISRV'
